# Butler v0.0.18

## Change Log

- Kept active app turns observable when long-running transcripts keep growing by
  making session summary use direct canonical store reads instead of full
  session-view construction. (#46)
- Made App transcript projection incremental after the first snapshot so active
  progress polling does not repeatedly rescan large transcript files. (#46)
- Marked final-result App transport events as projected so delivered turns stay
  terminal and late progress noise cannot keep the UI stuck on Thinking. (#46)
